The '''Senex-Juvex Loop''' was the primary [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] loop for the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

It served the primary [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of [[Karfeddion/Legends|Karfeddion]], [[Senex/Legends|Senex]], [[Velga Prime]], and [[Kassido]].
